easier.line: Do you find it gets a little easier
stanza: Do you find it gets a little easier
Each time you make it disappear?
Oh fools, the magician bends the rules
As the crowd watches his every move

easier.line: It's like you see right through me and make it easier
stanza: And baby, the way you move me, it's crazy
It's like you see right through me and make it easier
And believe me, you don't even have to try
